searchText: PSA: We're moving the 1-day devnet plans by at least a few days. The plan was Mon setup & Tue launch, but we could move it to Thu setup & Fri launch (and stop again before the weekend). Me, the Prysm team, and others here had to react to a recent incident on mainnet eth2, so we need more time for devnet preparation. ``` | PT (-7) | UTC | CET (+2) | AEST (+10) | | 10:00 Mon | 17:00 Mon April 26 | 19:00 Mon | 03:00 Tue | | 02:00 Fri | 09:00 Fri April 30 | 11:00 Fri | 19:00 Fri | ``` Reminder, office hours same time as last week. > If you are into UI design is UI help still needed for Rayonism? I’d like to know that too actually One example is to make a faucet website for later testnet use, but that thing has already been implemented (https://github.com/rauljordan/eth-faucet). There may also be other types of website tooling. The same part on the rayonism.io site also mentions data analysis. Any kind of visualization of data that helps us understand the testnets better is helpful. Anyway, the point is that if you feel motivated, but not a protocol dev, you can still help.
